# Speedrun.com — recording a wrapped game

- Original source: [Speedrun.com — recording a wrapped game](https://www.speedrun.com/de-DE/robinhood/forums/mjg89)
- Author / publication: MasterEbro and 23Banzaj / Speedrun.com forum
- Language / date: English discussion; exact dates not verified
- Access: Discussion text inspected
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

MasterEbro reports receiving audio with a black image when recording through OBS or Game Bar while using a windowing wrapper. Another participant suggests alternative capture tools and windowed operation.

The original poster later reports success after changing a checkbox and a value in the wrapper configuration. Those settings are not named, so the exchange does not provide a reproducible fix.

This is a firsthand compatibility lead for recording old Windows graphics through wrappers. It supports checking capture configuration, but does not establish a general solution or prove that the game renderer itself is faulty.
